formulations.label: Tablets (clinic product)
formulations.note: No UK SmPC for a simeticone-only tablet was found (emc and MHRA products index). Content is from a UK simeticone 100 mg soft capsule SmPC (same active ingredient, oral route); the levothyroxine interaction is from a UK infant oral suspension SmPC.

src.q: Each Capsules contains simeticone 100mg

bnf.note: BNF/BNFC is only available in the UK; not accessed.

items.t: Symptomatic relief of flatulence, wind pains, bloating, abdominal distension and other symptoms of intestinal gas.

src.q: Anti-flatulent defoaming agent for the symptomatic relief of flatulence, wind pains, bloating, abdominal distension and other symptoms associated with intestinal gas

restrictions.note: No prescribing restriction stated in the UK SmPC accessed (UK 100 mg capsule SmPC).

items.t: Capsule SmPC: adults, elderly and children, 100-200 mg (one or two 100 mg capsules) 3 or 4 times daily, or as required. No UK dose for the clinic tablet strengths.

src.q: Adults, the elderly and children: One or two capsules taken 3 or 4 times daily or as required for relief

items.t: Capsule SmPC gives the same dose for children as adults; no lower age limit is stated.

src.q: Adults, the elderly and children: One or two capsules taken 3 or 4 times daily or as required for relief

items.t: Hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients.

src.q: Hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients.

cautions.note: The UK 100 mg capsule SmPC section 4.4 states none.

src.q: other forms of interaction None reported.

items.t: Infant oral suspension SmPC: levothyroxine may bind to simeticone; levothyroxine absorption may be reduced if given at the same time to infants treated for thyroid disorders.

src.q: Levothyroxine may bind to simeticone.
Absorption of levothyroxine may be impaired if Dentinox Infant Colic Drops are given concurrently to infants treated for thyroid disorders.

renal.note: No renal impairment advice in the UK SmPC accessed (UK 100 mg capsule SmPC).

hepatic.note: No hepatic impairment advice in the UK SmPC accessed (UK 100 mg capsule SmPC).

items.t: Not absorbed, so no adverse effect on pregnancy is expected; as with all drugs, use with caution. No BUMPS leaflet for simeticone found.

src.q: As dimeticone is not absorbed, it is not anticipated that WindSetlers will have any adverse effects on pregnancy and lactation. However, as with all drugs, caution should be exercised in these conditions.

items.t: SmPC: not absorbed, so no adverse effect expected; use with caution.

src.q: As dimeticone is not absorbed, it is not anticipated that WindSetlers will have any adverse effects on pregnancy and lactation. However, as with all drugs, caution should be exercised in these conditions.

items.t: SPS: preferred choice in breastfeeding; excretion into milk unlikely; no specific infant monitoring usually needed.

src.q: Simeticone can be used during breastfeeding.
Excretion into breast milk is unlikely due to the very high molecular weight.

reproductive.note: No fertility information in the UK SmPC accessed (UK 100 mg capsule SmPC).

items.t: Minor effects: nausea and constipation (frequency not stated).

src.q: Minor adverse effects: nausea and constipation.

items.t: Rare hypersensitivity: rash, pruritus, facial or tongue oedema, breathing difficulty.

src.q: Rarely, hypersensitivity reactions such as rash, pruritis, facial oedema, tongue oedema and respiratory difficulty have been reported.

monitoring.note: No monitoring requirements stated in the UK SmPC accessed (UK 100 mg capsule SmPC).

administration.note: No administration advice beyond oral use in the UK SmPC accessed (UK 100 mg capsule SmPC).

counselling.note: No specific counselling points in the UK SmPC accessed (UK 100 mg capsule SmPC).

rules.consequence: Levothyroxine may bind to simeticone. The infant suspension SmPC says levothyroxine absorption may be impaired if the two are given at the same time to infants treated for thyroid disorders; the adult capsule SmPC reports no interactions.
